title: ガーディアンズがレイズに3-2で勝ち、2勝1敗とした
title_zh: 守护者队3比2击败光芒队，系列赛2比1领先

image.credit: Photo by Paulo Cristovam on Unsplash
image.author: Paulo Cristovam

lead: アメリカの野球のプレーオフで、クリーブランド・ガーディアンズがタンパベイ・レイズに3-2で勝ちました。これでガーディアンズは2勝1敗となりました。
lead_zh: 在美国棒球季后赛中，克利夫兰守护者队以3比2战胜了坦帕湾光芒队。守护者队目前以2胜1负领先。
preview: 木曜日の第3戦で、ペティ・ハルピンが2ランホームランを打ちました。これでガーディアンズが逆転しました。先発のギャビン・ウィリアムズは5回で9人から三振をとりました。
preview_zh: 在周四的第三场比赛中，佩蒂·哈尔平打出了一支两分本垒打。守护者队因此反超比分。先发投手加文·威廉姆斯投了5局，三振了9名打者。
paragraphs: 木曜日の第3戦で、ペティ・ハルピンが2ランホームランを打ちました。これでガーディアンズが逆転しました。先発のギャビン・ウィリアムズは5回で9人から三振をとりました。
ホセ・ラミレスは2本のヒットを打ちました。ネイサン・ロウは1打点をあげました。ガーディアンズのリリーフは最後の12人のうち11人をアウトにしました。
レイズは7回で三者凡退でした。

光芒队有7局都是三人出局。朱尼尔·卡米内罗被三振了4次。光芒队打者本场比赛共被三振13次。第四场比赛将在周五进行，但预报有雨。

title_original: Petey Halpin’s two-run homer lifts Guardians past Rays for 2-1 ALCS lead
summary_original:
Halpin’s first playoff homer puts Cleveland ahead
Williams strikes out nine as Guardians win 3-2
Cleveland bullpen retires 11 of final 12 Rays batters
Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead two-run homer, Gavin Williams struck out nine over five innings and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in Game 3 of the American League Championship Series on Thursday to take a 2-1 lead.
Game 4 of the best-of-seven series is scheduled for Friday, though rain is forecast.

body_original:
Petey Halpin’s two-run homer lifts Guardians past Rays for 2-1 ALCS lead
Halpin’s first playoff homer puts Cleveland ahead
Williams strikes out nine as Guardians win 3-2
Cleveland bullpen retires 11 of final 12 Rays batters
Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead two-run homer, Gavin Williams struck out nine over five innings and the
Cleveland Guardians
beat the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in Game 3 of the American League Championship Series on Thursday to take a 2-1 lead.
Game 4 of the best-of-seven series is scheduled for Friday, though rain is forecast.
José Ramírez had two hits and Nathaniel Lowe added an RBI for the Guardians, who have won five of their last six playoff games since falling 2-0 behind the Chicago White Sox in their AL Division Series.
Williams allowed two runs over five innings while walking one. He is 2-0 with a 2.16 ERA and 33 strikeouts over 16 and two-thirds innings innings in four postseason appearances this year, including three starts.
Cleveland retired 16 of the Rays’ final 17 batters. Daniel Espino, Erik Sabrowski, Hunter Gaddis and Cade Smith combined to allow just one baserunner over the final four innings.
Smith stranded a runner at third in the eighth when he struck out Yandy Díaz after a 10-pitch at-bat, then retired the side in order in the ninth.
Tampa Bay went down in order in seven innings, with Junior Caminero striking out four times. Rays batters struck out 13 times in Game 3 after combining for 14 in the first two games of the series.
Lowe opened the scoring with an RBI double in the second that bounced off the right-field fence and past Victor Mesa Jr.
Chandler Simpson put the Rays ahead with a two-run triple in the fourth.
Patrick Bailey led off the fifth with a chopper that pitcher Griffin Jax was unable to field cleanly. Halpin then connected on an elevated 95.9mph sinker on a 2-2 count, driving it 385ft into the right-center-field stands to give Cleveland a 3-2 lead.
It was Halpin’s first postseason home run and only the fifth of his two-year major league career. Jax had not allowed a homer since 9 September, a span of five appearances.
Williams did not allow a baserunner and struck out five the first time through the order.
Jax allowed three runs on five hits and two walks in four-plus innings.
